WS-021
Date: 2026-08-13
Purpose: Determine exactly how the live Cytube client configures and uses Socket.IO/Engine.IO, and compare that behavior against the manually constructed WebSocket requests from WS-019 and WS-020.

WS-018 established:
    polling works
    WebSocket-client receives HTTP 400

WS-019 established:
    raw RFC6455 WebSocket request reaches cytu.be
    HTTP 400 is returned
    response body is:
        {"code":3,"message":"Bad request"}

WS-020 established:
    fresh polling SID is valid
    SID-bound WebSocket receives HTTP 400
    SID remains active afterward
    direct WebSocket without SID also receives HTTP 400

WS-021 therefore does NOT primarily test another WebSocket client.

Instead it determines:
    1. Which Socket.IO/Engine.IO client Cytube actually serves
    2. Which version/configuration it uses
    3. Which socket path it uses
    4. Which transports it requests
    5. Whether the live browser client attempts WebSocket
    6. Whether the browser client falls back to polling
    7. Whether Cytube uses parameters that our tests have omitted
    8. Whether alternate Engine.IO URL forms behave differently

Target:
    https://cytu.be/r/EMAIL

Evidence type:
    EXPERIMENTALLY-CONFIRMED
